A.text: 4K AI Upscaling with 20 AI neural networks
VRR games up to 4K 144 Hz (with 4K 120Hz applicable for 2.47 m QN90D)
Quantum Matrix Technology with Quantum Mini LEDs
Dolby Atmos with Object Tracking Sound+
125+ free TV channels via Samsung TV Plus
2 Years Warranty (1 Year Standard + 1 Year Extended Warranty on Panel Only)
Supports Bixby and Amazon Alexa voice assistants

B.text: Features a 1.89 m (75-inch) Neo QLED 4K display
Powered by NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor
4K AI Upscaling technology is powered by 20 AI neural networks
Quantum Matrix Technology precisely controls proprietary Quantum Mini LEDs for ultra-fine light control
Motion Xcelerator 144Hz supports VRR games up to 4K 144 Hz
4K 120Hz is applicable for the 2.47 m (98-inch) QN90D model
Provides access to 125+ free TV channels via Samsung TV Plus
Built-in Dolby Atmos with top channel speakers
Comes with 2 Years Warranty (1 Year Standard + 1 Year Extended Warranty on Panel Only)
Dimensions of 75-inch model: 166.0 x 72.2 x 6.9 (HxWxD, mm)

C.text: The TV features a 4K AI processor (NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor) that creates one of the best 4K experiences with 4K AI Upscaling powered by 20 AI neural networks.
The TV includes Quantum Matrix Technology with ultra-fine light control for precise detail in both dark and bright scenes.
The TV supports Motion Xcelerator up to 4K 144Hz for ultra-smooth action without lag and motion blur.
The TV features Dolby Atmos® for next-level audio experience with top channel speakers.
The TV runs Samsung Tizen OS, allowing access to Samsung TV Plus with 125+ free channels.
The TV supports voice assistants Bixby, Alexa, and has a built-in microphone switch for voice input features.
The TV is VESA compliant and can be wall-mounted with any compatible wall mount.
The TV offers a 2-year warranty (1 year standard + 1 year extended on panel only).
The TV includes Smart Calibration that automatically adjusts brightness, contrast, and color for cinematic viewing.
The TV supports object tracking sound+ with Dolby Atmos for immersive audio experience.
The TV has a 75-inch screen size.
The TV is a Neo QLED 4K model with AI-powered picture and sound optimization.

D.text: Neo QLED display with Quantum Mini LEDs and Quantum Matrix Technology
Built-in Bixby and Alexa voice assistants
2-year warranty (1 year standard + 1 year extended on panel only)
4K AI Upscaling powered by 20 neural networks
125+ free channels via Samsung TV Plus

E.text: The Samsung QN90D is a Neo QLED 4K Smart AI TV.
The QN90D uses the NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor.
Samsung says the 4K AI Upscaling technology is powered by 20 AI neural networks.
Samsung says VRR games are supported up to 4K 144 Hz.
Samsung says 4K 144Hz is only available with PC connected games that support those specifications.
Samsung TV Plus offers 125+ free channels on the QN90D.
Samsung says a Samsung account is required to access the full range of Samsung Tizen OS features.
The warranty policy listed for the QN90D is 2 years warranty.
Samsung states the warranty includes 1 year standard warranty plus 1 year extended warranty on the panel only.
The 75-inch QN90D listing shows a dimension of 166.0 x 72.2 x 6.9 mm.
